title: Global And Local Inversions
statement:
`nums` is a permutation of `[0, n - 1]`. A global inversion is a pair `i < j` with `nums[i] > nums[j]`; a local inversion is an index `i` with `nums[i] > nums[i + 1]`. Return whether the numbers of global and local inversions are equal.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,0,2]
Output: true
```

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,0]
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `nums` is a permutation of all integers in `[0, nums.length - 1]`
